source_text: Public health modeling supports VMMC scale-up in epidemic epicenters for cost-effective HIV control (cost per infection averted: $200-600), but in low-incidence settings, critics argue resources are better allocated to education, condoms, and PrEP, given circumcision's incomplete protection (40-50% residual risk) and reliance on high coverage rates unachievable without compulsion. [153]
